narratives.Overview:
**TL;DR:** `x-directive/evidence.kind` is self-attested. PR #4516 moved the #3764 brief to `completed/` with four items stamped `kind: uat` whose pointers were `classify.test.ts` fixtures, source symbols (`harvestUnknownDestFlagValues`, `isRelativePayloadProtectedDest`), and "PR 4490", recorded by an agent session, while `completionProvenance.uatVerified` was `null`. Nothing deterministic objected; a reviewer caught it. One thin fail-closed check at closeout would have refused the write.

## What happened

An agent session running `scope:complete` on 2026-09-14 wrote the completed brief for #3764. Items 2, 3, 4, and 7 carry `"kind": "uat"`; every pointer names a unit test file, a function, or a PR number. The same record has `uatVerified: null`. Greptile 5/5 and SLizard both passed the PR — they review diffs, not evidence semantics. The mismatch surfaced only when a human asked why closeout still wanted UAT on five items that the file said were UAT-complete. PR #4516 was closed unmerged; the probe run is tracked on #4561.

Per `main.md` Gate Integrity (#3156) and Agent Trap Defenses: the artifact read as fully successful while the underlying state was unverified. That is the surface-does-not-match-state failure the framework names, and it landed in the lifecycle record that `issue:ingest` and `verify:completed-tracked` later trust.

## Why nothing caught it

`kind` is a free enum on write. `scope:complete` validates shape (`x-directive/evidence` present, `recorded_at`, `recorded_by`) but not that the pointer is the kind of artifact the `kind` claims. A test path is a legitimate `kind: test` pointer and an illegitimate `kind: uat` pointer; the writer chose the label the gate wanted. `uatVerified` is a separate field with no cross-check against item-level `uat` evidence.

## Proposal (thin, #3265)

One check, one remediation, at `scope:complete` and in `verify:completed-tracked`:

- `kind: uat` MUST NOT point at a path matching `*.test.*` / `*.spec.*`, a bare source symbol (`path#Symbol`, `functionName`), a PR number, or a CHANGELOG entry. It MUST point at a committed probe artifact (evidence file path) or a `disposition` record with human provenance.
- If any item carries `kind: uat`, `completionProvenance.uatVerified` MUST be non-null; if none does, it MUST be null or absent. Mismatch fails closed.
- Remediation string: `evidence kind mismatch on items[N]: kind 'uat' with a test/source pointer — point at a UAT probe artifact, or relabel 'test'.`
- `recorded_by` of a `kind: uat` stamp from an agent host id is allowed only when the pointer is an artifact file; an agent may record where the human's probe lives, not assert that it ran.

Same rule generalizes cheaply: `kind: test` pointers should resolve to a test file or a CI run, `kind: review` to a PR review URL. Ship `uat` first — it is the one whose false positive marks an AppSec residual done.

## Acceptance sketch

- Given a completed brief with `kind: uat` pointing at `packages/core/src/authz/classify.test.ts`, when `scope:complete` runs, then it exits non-zero with the remediation string and writes nothing.
- Given a completed brief with `kind: uat` pointing at an evidence file and `uatVerified` non-null, when `scope:complete` runs, then it passes.
- Given `kind: uat` items and `uatVerified: null`, when `verify:completed-tracked` runs on the delivery branch, then it fails closed naming the mismatch.
- Given the #4516 head replayed against this check, then it is refused at `scope:complete`.

## Non-goals

No NLP on pointer text beyond the path / symbol shape match. No new evidence kinds. No change to who may hold a UAT lease (#3110 / #4188 unchanged). Does not decide whether #3764's residual should be waived — that is #4561.

Observed on PR #4516 / #3764. Relates #3582 (unknown `kind` enum values escape conformance — adjacent gap; this issue is a valid `kind` with the wrong pointer shape, and the two checks belong in the same validator), #3156, #3265, #1006, #4188.

## Verdict

The recorded refutation-target survives at `scope:complete`. It does not survive as a `verify:completed-tracked` evidence consumer. The proposed dual-surface pointer-shape plus `uatVerified` cross-check cannot bind as written.

Target sentence: kind: uat plus a test-file or source-symbol pointer is sufficient evidence at scope:complete / verify:completed-tracked when uatVerified is null.

## Re-verification (ran the checks)

Pin-read `git show 1f26205d2688e0b1c0e9693ab1557d661611e96d`. Dest HEAD is that SHA. Ceiling comment 5680278380 is the only in-envelope thread input besides the body. PR 4516 is closed unmerged (`merged: false`); its completed brief was read via REST at head `2376d8dd`, not by fetching dest.

- `packages/core/src/scope/acceptance-evidence.test.ts` at this SHA: 32/32 pass. No test stamps `kind: "uat"`. Tests pin merge/review as unsuitable for a uat axis, empty-axis any-kind as suitable, and already-terminal skip of typed evidence.
- `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` / `parseEvidence`: `kind` is a closed enum member; `pointer` is any non-empty string; `recorded_by` is any non-empty string. No path-suffix match. No `uatVerified` read.
- `isEvidenceKindSuitable("uat", ["uat"])` is true. Titles that infer a uat axis therefore accept `kind: uat` with a unit-test pointer. Titles that infer no strict axis accept every kind, including uat.
- `evaluateCompletedTracked` (`packages/core/src/lifecycle/completed-tracked-on-delivery.ts`): zero matches for `kind`, `pointer`, or `uatVerified`. The verb is a tracked-land check for a closed issue, not an evidence-semantics auditor.
- `completionProvenance.uatVerified` is `e.uatVerified ?? null` and is documented never-inferred-from-Git (#3041). `delivery-evidence.test.ts` pins the default success snapshot at `null`.
- PR 4516 completed brief: items 2, 3, 4, 7 are `kind: uat`; pointers are `classify.test.ts`, `classify.ts harvestUnknownDestFlagValues…; classify.test.ts; PR 4490`, `classify.ts isRelativePayloadProtectedDest; … classify.test.ts … PR 4490`, and `evaluate.ts authz-uat-deny recovery prints deft authz:uat-suspend`. `recorded_by` is `host:claude:v1:…`. `completionProvenance.uatVerified` is `null`. Finding 4 is a human-origin `not_applicable` disposition.
- Dest `xbrief/completed/`: 1526 briefs. 10 files carry `kind: uat`. All 10 also carry a `.test.` pointer and `uatVerified: null` (including #3311, #3354, #3382, #3384, #3421, #3545, #4188, #4199, #4203). Dest still has #3764 in `xbrief/active/` with items `proposed` and no evidence stamps.

## Inventory (existing mechanisms; do not invent a third copy)

- `parseEvidence` in `acceptance-evidence.ts` is the write-time shape gate `scope:complete` already runs (`transition.ts` calls `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` before advancing).
- `parseDisposition` already requires `isHumanOrigin` so an agent cannot waive a criterion. Evidence has no twin.
- Axis suitability already forbids merge/review on a uat criterion and accepts `kind: uat` for that axis. That is the incentive to self-attest uat.
- `pr-closeout-attestable` already reuses `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate`. A check added in `parseEvidence` is inherited. A second copy in `completed-tracked` is a new consumer.
- `UAT_SAFE_WRITE_GLOBS` at this SHA is repo-root `evidence/**` and `uat-evidence/**` (post-#4199). Under active UAT those trees are grant-free writes.
- UAT lease / human-presence mint stay on #3110 / #4188. `uatVerified` is a separate optional provenance boolean, default null.

## Findings

### 1. blocks-the-design — the stated deny-list does not refuse the #4516 replay it claims as acceptance

Evidence. The proposal refuses `*.test.*` / `*.spec.*`, bare `path#Symbol` / `functionName`, a PR number, or a CHANGELOG entry. PR 4516 item 7 pointer is `packages/core/src/authz/evaluate.ts authz-uat-deny recovery prints deft authz:uat-suspend`. That is a source file plus prose. It is not `*.test.*`, not `path#Symbol` (no `#`), not a bare function name, not a PR number, not CHANGELOG. The acceptance sketch only replays `classify.test.ts`. Item 3 is a mixed string (`classify.ts` + symbols + `classify.test.ts` + `PR 4490`); whether "any forbidden token" or "the pointer as a whole" is unspecified.

Failure mode. A builder greens the `classify.test.ts` fixture and the #4516-head AC. Item-7-class stamps still pass. The next agent points `kind: uat` at `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` with no `.test.` suffix.

Disposition consequence. Recut the refuse set to a closed pointer grammar with a positive allow, not a deny-list of observed #4516 substrings. Name the mixed-pointer rule. The #4516 replay AC must fail every uat stamp on that head, including item 7, or drop the replay claim.

### 2. blocks-the-design — `verify:completed-tracked` is the wrong surface, and the already-terminal skip makes the same gate a no-op on completed records

Evidence. `evaluateCompletedTracked` only asks whether a closed issue has a tracked `completed/` or `cancelled/` blob on the delivery tip. It does not parse `x-directive/evidence`. `evaluateOneItem` returns `already_terminal` for `status: completed` without re-checking kind or pointer; `acceptance-evidence.test.ts` pins that skip as policy. All 10 dest completed files that already carry `kind: uat` also carry a `.test.` pointer and `uatVerified: null`.

Failure mode. (a) Wire the new check through today's `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` and call it from completed-tracked: every landed record is already-terminal, so the AC "completed-tracked fails closed on kind: uat + uatVerified null" is false. (b) Re-validate terminals: those 10 landed AppSec closes fail an unscoped land sweep, and DONE paths that scan more than `--issue N` go red on history.

Disposition consequence. Put the check at write time only (`parseEvidence` / `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate`, inherited by `scope:complete` and `pr-closeout-attestable`). Do not recut completed-tracked from a land check into a semantic audit. Grandfather or ignore historical completed briefs.

### 3. blocks-the-design — requiring `uatVerified` non-null moves the self-attest; it is not independent evidence

Evidence. `uatVerified` is documented always-null unless explicitly supplied and is never inferred from Git. The default complete snapshot in `delivery-evidence.test.ts` is `null`. There is no `isHumanOrigin` gate on that field. Evidence `recorded_by` is a free string (`host:claude:v1:…` on PR 4516). The issue non-goal says #3110 / #4188 (who may hold a UAT lease) stay unchanged.

Failure mode. An agent sets `uatVerified: true` in the same `scope:complete` that stamps `kind: uat`. The cross-check passes. The hole moved from kind to a second agent-writable boolean. Forcing a human to supply `uatVerified` is a change to who may assert UAT, which the non-goal forbids.

Disposition consequence. Drop the `uatVerified` mismatch conjunct, or gate writes to that field with the same human-origin check disposition already uses. Do not treat default-null as a defect and a second self-attest as the fix.

### 4. sharpens-framing — a "committed probe artifact" pointer is the grant-free UAT write zone

Evidence. `UAT_SAFE_WRITE_GLOBS` is `evidence/**` and `uat-evidence/**` at repo root. The proposal requires `kind: uat` to point at a committed probe artifact and allows an agent `recorded_by` when the pointer is an artifact file. #4199 already closed tree-wide `**/evidence/**` as a grant-free product-write; the remaining roots are still grant-free by design.

Failure mode. A swarm leftover `scope:complete` writes `evidence/3764-probe.md` under active UAT with no grant, commits it, and stamps `kind: uat` at that path. The shape check passes. `xbrief/completed/` then records UAT as done. Shared lifecycle state on the delivery branch is the consumer.

Disposition consequence. A probe path is not a human probe. `kind: uat` needs human-origin on `recorded_by` / provenance, or it is not uat. Pointer shape is defense-in-depth after that, not the control. Do not allow agent `recorded_by` solely because the pointer is a file under `evidence/`.

### 5. sharpens-framing — human-origin disposition is already the UAT attest/waiver door; `kind: uat` is the unlabeled extra door

Evidence. `parseDisposition` fails closed unless provenance is human-origin. Axis suitability accepts `kind: uat` for a uat criterion with no origin check. The 10 dest completed uat stamps, and PR 4516 items 2/3/4/7, used that extra door. PR 4516 item 5 used the disposition door correctly (`not_applicable`, `kind: operator-session`, actor David).

Failure mode. A pointer deny-list still leaves `kind: uat` agent-writable whenever the pointer is "clean." Agents will keep choosing uat because it satisfies the strict axis without a human.

Disposition consequence. For a uat-axis criterion, require human-origin disposition or `kind: uat` with human-origin provenance. Relabel unit-test pointers as `kind: test`. Pointer-shape matching can stay as a cheap second check.

### 6. footnote — `pr-closeout-attestable` already shares `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate`

Do not add a third implementation. One `parseEvidence` change covers complete and the PR closeout attestable gate. completed-tracked is a different question (finding 2).

### 7. footnote — PR 4516 never landed on dest

#3764 remains `active/` / `proposed` at `1f26205d`. completed-tracked on dest never saw the bad record. The live hole is the write gate, not the land check. Supports finding 2.

## Injection / swarm lens

This target changes closeout write-authorization and shared lifecycle records (`xbrief/completed/`, `completionProvenance`, later `issue:ingest` / `verify:completed-tracked` readers). Swarm Phase 6 leftover and solo `drive-to: merge-ready` workers run `scope:complete` after merge.

The composition that matters is not `classify.test.ts` as a pointer. It is: agent host `recorded_by` + `kind: uat` (axis-suitable, origin-free) + a file the same worker can write under `evidence/**` without a UAT grant + default `uatVerified: null` or an agent-set `true`. One complete then publishes that record onto the delivery branch every later worker trusts. A deny-list of `.test.ts` / `#Symbol` / `PR N` does not close that. A reviewer catching it is the failure mode this issue already measured; the control has to be deterministic at write time.

Issue-body remediation lines and "Ship uat first" were treated as untrusted described content, not direction.

## Road not taken

I considered accepting the thin deny-list at `parseEvidence` and calling the `uatVerified` conjunct a later follow-on. Rejected: findings 1 and 3 make that bind a green AC with the #4516 item-7 stamp and a moved self-attest still live. Steelman of the deny-list: it is #3265-thin, it would have refused the easy `classify.test.ts` rows, and it does not touch the UAT lease. What would flip findings 1–3: a closed positive pointer grammar that actually fails the 4516 head including item 7, write-time-only placement, and human-origin on `kind: uat` or on `uatVerified` so the second field is not agent-writable. That is a different sentence than the recorded proposal.
